title: log.export
description: Export a window of log entries to a JSON file at a user-chosen path. The format is fixed to JSON; the format field is retained for forward compatibility but is not surfaced as a user setting.

filePath.description: Absolute filesystem path of the export target. Parent directory must exist and be writable.

format.description: Fixed to 'json' in v1. Reserved for forward compatibility; not surfaced as a user setting.

levelMin.description: Optional minimum severity bound. Defaults to debug.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 lower bound on entry time (inclusive).

until.description: Optional ISO-8601 upper bound on entry time (exclusive).

includeDiagnostics.description: Include source = 'diagnostic' entries. Defaults to false for exports.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the written file. Equal to the requested filePath on success.

bytes.description: Optional byte size of the written file.

code.description: Source mapping: path.write.denied (crates/app/core/src/log_stream.rs:59), path.parent.missing (log_stream.rs:60), range.invalid (log_stream.rs:61), format.unsupported (log_stream.rs:62), database.error (log_stream.rs:64-86), serialise.error (log_stream.rs:65, 88-90), io.error (log_stream.rs:66, 91-93), export.unfinished_file (log_stream.rs:67, 94-96). Command-level failures originate in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands/log.rs:99-132; shared wire names are defined in crates/contracts/core/src/error_code.rs:467-486.

path.description: For export.unfinished_file, absolute path of the unfinished export (crates/app/errors/src/lib.rs:174-176).
